research_mode: official data.police.uk and Department for Transport primary sources only; anonymisation, provenance, API retrieval, STATS19 coverage, revision, severity and quality gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: STATS19 complete-series availability
verified_claims: complete collision, vehicle and casualty datasets are available from 1979 to the latest final year
limitations: long series cross multiple specification and reporting changes

sources.name: STATS19 five-year subset availability
verified_claims: five-year subset files are provided for users who do not need the complete historical dataset
limitations: subset files do not include records outside their stated period

sources.name: Road casualty guidance scope
verified_claims: the guidance brings together coverage, definitions, quality, methodology and technical documentation
limitations: guidance describes the statistical system and is not collision evidence

sources.name: Police-reported STATS19 source gate
verified_claims: road casualty statistics are based on data reported by police through STATS19
limitations: police reporting coverage and practice affect observed counts

sources.name: STATS19 known-issues registry
verified_claims: the guidance links to a maintained known-data-issues page and revisions information
limitations: quality checks must use the issue state applicable to the downloaded release

sources.name: STATS19 methodology family
verified_claims: separate methodology documents cover provisional statistics, drink-drive statistics and other specialised outputs
limitations: methods from one output should not be applied automatically to another

sources.name: STATS19 2024 specification gate
verified_claims: the latest collection specification identified by the guidance is the 2024 STATS19 specification
limitations: historic records can follow earlier specifications

sources.name: STATS20 police guidance gate
verified_claims: STATS20 provides detailed guidance issued to police for the STATS19 collection
limitations: guidance compliance cannot be assumed identical across every force and record

sources.name: STATS19 review governance
verified_claims: periodic reviews are overseen by the Standing Committee on Road Injury Collision Statistics
limitations: review governance does not remove record-level uncertainty

sources.name: STATS19 sensitive personal-data gate
verified_claims: underlying STATS19 data include sensitive fields that may identify individuals or assign blame and are not routinely published
limitations: public analysis must not reconstruct restricted personal information

sources.name: Road casualty accredited-statistics status
verified_claims: road casualty statistics are accredited official statistics under the Code of Practice for Statistics
limitations: accreditation does not make every row exact or complete

sources.name: STATS19 provider training variation
verified_claims: most forces provide some training and quality assurance for STATS19 data
limitations: training and assurance organisation varies across forces

sources.name: STATS19 collection-practice variation
verified_claims: data-provider research found variation in STATS19 organisation and practices across police forces
limitations: cross-force differences can reflect collection practice as well as road risk

sources.name: STATS19 road-safety-factor recording caveat
verified_claims: provider research identified multiple possible reasons for changes in road-safety-factor recording without a definitive explanation
limitations: factor trends should not be assigned a single cause without further evidence

sources.name: STATS19 future injury-severity research
verified_claims: a later research phase is planned to examine injury-severity recording across police-force areas
limitations: planned research is not evidence that current severity differences have been resolved
